Router X announces its router-LSA to the neighbors as follows. 1) costs of all non-stub links (links of the types other than 3) are set to LSInfinity (16-bit value 0xFFFF, rather than 24-bit value 0xFFFFFF used in summary and AS-external LSAs). 2) costs of stub links (type 3) are set to the interface output cost.
